subject: SOC2 re-attestation & renewal: evidence request + capacity amendment
messages:
From: Jamal Akbar <jamal.akbar@finbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-01T16:12:00Z
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation for renewal + capacity amendment request

Hi Neha,

As we move toward the mid-August renewal for our Redwood contract, Security has asked me to collect a short package of materials for re-attestation. We also want to confirm an increase in dedicated capacity (4 -> 8 GPUs) as part of the renewal and need the contract amendment language.

Can you please provide the following by EOD 2026-08-09?
- SOC 2 Type II report covering 2025 (redacted OK) + SSP or a short summary of covered controls
- List of control owners and contact points for any security questions
- Snapshot of current retention settings and a sample of audit/log exports (S3/object store or CSV export) for the last 90 days
- Encryption-in-transit and at-rest attestations (KMS/HSM details) and key rotation cadence
- Confirmation of where customer logs are retained and how long (we have a 7-year retention requirement internally)

On the capacity side, procurement needs an estimated delta in monthly committed spend for the 4->8 GPU increase and whether any SLA or region constraints change. If you can include a short pricing matrix and proposed amendment language, that would keep our legal and procurement teams moving.

Thanks — we need to confirm by next Monday to keep the scheduled renewal timeline.

Best,
Jamal Akbar
Director, Information Security
FinBank

Date: 2026-08-02T13:22:00Z
Subject: Internal: FinBank renewal — SOC2 evidence & capacity amendment (DBL-4872)

Team — looping you in on FinBank. Jamal asked for SOC2 re-attestation materials and a capacity increase to 8 GPUs (current commit is 4). Timeline is tight — customer requested materials by 2026-08-09 and confirmation for procurement to keep the mid-August renewal.

What I need from each of you:
- Hiro: export a 90-day audit-log sample, retention snapshot, and provide guidance on fields included and redaction steps. Ideally a gzipped CSV we can send.
- Laura: draft amendment language that includes retention language (customer requires a 7-year clause) and the capacity delta with monthly committed spend. Keep redlines light — customer is sensitive to broad indemnities.
- Marcus: confirm pricing matrix and the delta (attach pricing_capacity_matrix.xlsx). We should propose a 3% discount on the incremental commit if they sign a 12-month extension.
- Rishi/Monica: coordinate any product/security clarifications for Jamal; if they request an on-call security review we can offer a 30-min technical walk-through.

I'll coordinate delivery and send the combined package to Jamal on 2026-08-05 after legal review.

—Neha
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T21:41:00Z
Subject: Re: Internal: FinBank renewal — SOC2 evidence & capacity amendment (DBL-4872)

Neha / all — I can provide the audit-log export and retention snapshot. Notes:
- Export will be a gzipped CSV (audit_log_export_2026-08-01.csv.gz) with timestamp, request_id, api_key_hash (hashed), model_id, route, response_size, latency_ms, region, and action (create/generate/embedding). We will not include PII or full prompt text in the sample; prompts are redacted per our policy.
- Retention settings: currently customer logs retained for 90 days by default, configurable per-account; we'll include a snapshot of the account-level setting and the mechanism to change it.
- Encryption: we will include KMS key IDs and a short note on rotation cadence. For HSM/KMS specifics that are beyond the redacted report, we can provide a high-level attestation.

I'll upload the two files to the secure drive and share the links. Expected delivery: 2026-08-04 EOD.

Attachment (will be included): audit_log_export_2026-08-01.csv.gz

—Hiro
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
hiro_tanaka@redwood.com
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-05T18:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Internal: FinBank renewal — draft amendment and pricing

Team — I drafted a short amendment that covers: (1) increase to committed capacity (4 -> 8 GPUs) with pricing delta; (2) data retention clause stating customer may request retention up to 7 years and Redwood will provide mechanisms and estimates for long-term retention exports; (3) standard SLA notes remain unchanged.

Key points for negotiation:
- We should avoid committing to storage costs beyond a defined export/hosting fee; propose a one-time export fee + monthly archival hosting if they opt-in.
- Procurement will want a simple monthly delta number. I used Marcus's inputs to put the delta at $12,400/month for the additional 4 GPUs (see attached pricing matrix).

I attached: renewal_amendment_draft.docx (redline-ready). Please review quickly; I plan to send to Jamal on 2026-08-06 morning unless there are objections.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Date: 2026-08-09T23:05:00Z
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation for renewal + capacity amendment request

Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround and to your team for the artifacts. The SOC2_summary and redacted report look good; the audit log sample and retention snapshot address the bulk of our compliance questions. A few notes:

- We accept the proposed amendment language with the export/hosting fee approach (Procurement will issue the PO for the delta + one-time export fee).
- Security is satisfied with the log sample; we may request a short 30-min technical call next week to walk Hiro through our internal ingestion/archival process.
- For the 7-year retention ask, Procurement will approve the amendment provided there is a documented export process and cost estimate (your proposed one-time export fee + monthly archival fee is fine).

I'll route the PO this week (target: 2026-08-12) and will share the DocuSign link for signature. Please prepare final amendment and invoice reflecting the $12,400/month delta and the agreed export fee.

Appreciate the help — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Jamal
